description:
Equipped with Bosch e-assist

With a whisper quiet motor capable of 75Nm of torque, this system is wickedly fun. Go from the “all-day ride” Eco mode to an exhilarating Turbo mode with a few clicks of a button on your Smart LED Remote.

The Bosch Smart System ushers in the digital eBike future by fully connecting the eBike Flow app with all eBike components. This allows for over-the-air updates and continuous new functions, like navigation and enhanced theft protection, keeping your eBike current and your riding experience personalized.

The Rebel takes everything riders love about the Rambler and turns it into TerraTrike’s most approachable recumbent trike yet. Built for new riders and anyone ready to move more, feel better, and ride with confidence. The Rebel is stable, friendly, and unintimidating from the very first pedal stroke. Tall, 24” wheels all around and a wide stance deliver a smooth, confident ride that feels instantly familiar. With an 18” high seat, getting on, getting going, and getting comfortable is refreshingly easy.

Whether you’re chasing better health, fresh air, or a new way to enjoy cycling, the Rebel proves that getting started doesn’t have to be hard or expensive. Just hop on, relax, and start pedaling toward something better.

Key Features

18” seat height for easier entry, exit.
24” wheels front and rear for balanced handling and visibility.
Wide, confidence-inspiring stance for stability and control.
Comfortable, supportive wide seat built for real-world riding.
Simple, intuitive drivetrain that’s easy to understand and easy to maintain.
Affordable, high-quality steel platform—a true gateway to recumbent trike riding.

The Rebel lowers the barrier to entry and raises expectations.

Because riding different shouldn’t be complicated.

*Please note - This TerraTrike comes equipped with our Comfort Pedal Conversion Kit!

The Battery Network – Bosch Battery Fee
Please note: a $15 recycling fee will be added to the price of every Bosch product with the new Smart System. This program provides support for battery recycling to riders like you! Learn more about the initiative here: batterynetwork.org
